This caused signSession() to throw "no active signing key selected" before a token could even be minted.

Fix: Set both activeKid (identity-service/src/config.ts) and trustedKid (ledger-service/src/config.ts) to "k_quartz" — the key the platform originally shipped with (confirmed by team memory OPS-522). Both now default to k_quartz with env-variable overrides (IDENTITY_ACTIVE_KID / LEDGER_TRUSTED_KID) for production. This ensures the issuer signs with the same key the verifier trusts. No other changes were needed: the canonical claim strings already match between services, and the gateway passes the token verbatim.
